title: tephrosia colutea var. dembianensis
intro: Tephrosia colutea var. dembianensis, commonly known as Ethiopian lupin, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tephrosia colutea var. dembianensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-hypertensive properties.
